requirements.text: 6+ years of hands-on software or infrastructure engineering experience, including building and operating production systems at scale.
6+ years of hands-on software or infrastructure engineering experience, including building and operating production systems at scale.
Broad infrastructure experience on at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Breadth and fundamentals matter more than expertise in one specific cloud.
Deep expertise in at least one layer of the stack, such as compute, orchestration, networking, or deploys, plus a real interest in owning the layers next to it.
Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred) and container orchestration (Kubernetes).
Strong coding skills and a bias toward automation and tooling. Go experience is a plus.
Strong coding skills and a bias toward automation and tooling. Go experience is a plus.
A pragmatic, scrappy approach. You can start with a rough prototype and evolve it into production ready.
Curiosity and flexibility. You adapt to new clouds, tools, and customer requirements instead of forcing every problem into one familiar pattern.
A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Experience running infrastructure across multiple clouds and many regions or environments.
Experience with compliance-driven environments (FedRAMP, SOC 2, HIPAA, or financial services).
Experience building deploy systems, CI/CD, or internal developer platforms.
Experience deploying software into customer-managed cloud environments.
An SRE background, or experience leading reliability and incident management programs.
Experience with distributed databases such as DynamoDB or Spanner.
Experience at a fast-paced startup or on a small infrastructure team with broad scope.
